title: 真实离线PEP517交付：运行wheel齐备仍缺构建依赖，隔离构建后运行环境不带构建工具
body:
## 操作任务
实现deliver(run,case)，run(argv)实际调用python -m pip并返回(code,stdout,stderr)。先wheel case.source，--no-index --no-cache-dir，分别--find-links case.runtime_wheels和case.build_wheels，保留默认PEP517构建隔离，--no-deps仅停止收集应用运行依赖，--wheel-dir case.output；成功后install其中opsforge_application-1.0-py3-none-any.whl，--no-index --no-cache-dir --find-links运行wheel目录 --target case.target，不使用--no-deps。任一步非0立即RuntimeError。输入及源文件不改，不安装到全局，不以--no-build-isolation掩盖缺构建依赖。真实仅运行wheel的初始构建失败；补充构建仓后隔离backend可导入buildhelper1.0，运行目录只安装应用和runtime2.0，独立-S解释器运行正常且无buildhelper。错误0.9构建仓必须失败且不继续安装。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实现有pip23/CPython3.11、纯Python自定义PEP517 backend和自有wheel，无网络、宿主安装或镜像构建。只验证本平台纯Python构建/运行依赖闭包，不证明跨平台ABI、原生编译链、签名仓库及所有动态构建依赖已交付。
answer:
```python
import pathlib
def deliver(run,case):
    args=['wheel','--no-index','--no-cache-dir','--find-links',case['runtime_wheels'],'--find-links',case['build_wheels'],'--no-deps','--wheel-dir',case['output'],case['source']]
    code,out,err=run(args)
    if code:raise RuntimeError('offline isolated build failed')
    artifact=str(pathlib.Path(case['output'])/'opsforge_application-1.0-py3-none-any.whl')
    code,out,err=run(['install','--no-index','--no-cache-dir','--find-links',case['runtime_wheels'],'--target',case['target'],artifact])
    if code:raise RuntimeError('offline runtime install failed')
```

原题知识说明：
交付目标Python版本、ABI、操作系统/架构以及全部依赖锁定清单，把可直接安装的wheel与需要构建的sdist分开。PEP 517隔离构建可能额外安装构建后端依赖，仅缓存应用requirements不能保证断网成功；应预制受审wheel并记录来源、摘要和构建环境。验收在无网络且无旧缓存的新环境安装，故意使用错误平台wheel、缺构建依赖和同名不同内容包，确认不能静默回源或改用未审版本。安装成功后验证入口、原生扩展加载和关键功能，不能只检查pip退出码。失败保持旧虚拟环境与旧依赖集合，修正离线仓库后重新创建环境；不要在生产环境临时开放公网或覆盖现有包来让安装通过。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 明确语言运行时与业务合同的边界
给出可区分正确与失败的具体样例
说明资源或数据恢复限制

test_files.checks/wheel_fixture.py:
"""Tiny valid pure-Python teaching wheels; standard library only, no package hooks."""
def wheel(directory,name,version,files,requires=()):
    import zipfile,base64,hashlib,csv,io,pathlib
    normalized=name.replace('-','_');info=normalized+'-'+version+'.dist-info'
    metadata='Metadata-Version: 2.1\nName: '+name+'\nVersion: '+version+'\n'
    for requirement in requires:metadata+='Requires-Dist: '+requirement+'\n'
    contents={key:value.encode() if isinstance(value,str) else value for key,value in files.items()}
    contents[info+'/METADATA']=(metadata+'\n').encode()
    contents[info+'/WHEEL']=b'Wheel-Version: 1.0\nGenerator: OpsForge teaching fixture\nRoot-Is-Purelib: true\nTag: py3-none-any\n'
    record=io.StringIO();writer=csv.writer(record,lineterminator='\n')
    for name_in_wheel,data in contents.items():writer.writerow((name_in_wheel,'sha256='+base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(data).digest()).decode().rstrip('='),len(data)))
    writer.writerow((info+'/RECORD','',''));contents[info+'/RECORD']=record.getvalue().encode()
    directory=pathlib.Path(directory);directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    filename=normalized+'-'+version+'-py3-none-any.whl'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(directory/filename,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        for name_in_wheel,data in contents.items():archive.writestr(name_in_wheel,data)
    return filename


def prepare(root):
    import inspect,pathlib
    root=pathlib.Path(root);runtime=root/'runtime-wheels';build=root/'build-wheels';wrong=root/'wrong-build';source=root/'source';source.mkdir()
    wheel(runtime,'opsforge-runtime','2.0',{'opsforge_runtime.py':'VALUE=7\n'})
    helper=inspect.getsource(wheel)+'''
def emit(directory):
    import json
    marker=dict(build_dependency='1.0',isolated='pip-build-env-' in __file__)
    return wheel(directory,'opsforge-application','1.0',{'opsforge_application.py':'from opsforge_runtime import VALUE\\nANSWER=VALUE+42\\n','opsforge_build_provenance.json':json.dumps(marker)},['opsforge-runtime==2.0'])
'''
    wheel(build,'opsforge-buildhelper','1.0',{'opsforge_buildhelper.py':helper})
    wheel(wrong,'opsforge-buildhelper','0.9',{'opsforge_buildhelper.py':helper})
    (source/'pyproject.toml').write_text('[build-system]\nrequires=["opsforge-buildhelper==1.0"]\nbuild-backend="backend"\nbackend-path=["."]\n')
    (source/'backend.py').write_text('import opsforge_buildhelper\ndef build_wheel(wheel_directory, config_settings=None, metadata_directory=None):\n    return opsforge_buildhelper.emit(wheel_directory)\n')
    return source,runtime,build,wrong
test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,json,copy,hashlib,importlib.util
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from wheel_fixture import prepare
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
assert importlib.util.find_spec('opsforge_buildhelper') is None
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-pep517-offline-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);source,runtime,build,wrong=prepare(root)
 env={**os.environ,'PIP_CONFIG_FILE':'/dev/null','PIP_NO_INDEX':'1','PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK':'1','PIP_CACHE_DIR':str(root/'cache'),'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1','PYTHONNOUSERSITE':'1'}
 calls=[]
 def run(args):
  calls.append(args[:]);p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pip',*args],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
 code,out,err=run(['wheel','--no-index','--no-cache-dir','--find-links',str(runtime),'--no-deps','--wheel-dir',str(root/'initial-output'),str(source)])
 assert code!=0 and 'opsforge-buildhelper' in out+err,'runtime-only wheelhouse unexpectedly satisfied build-system.requires'
 protected={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for folder in (source,runtime,build,wrong) for p in folder.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
 case=dict(source=str(source),runtime_wheels=str(runtime),build_wheels=str(build),output=str(root/'output'),target=str(root/'installed'));original=copy.deepcopy(case);calls.clear()
 print('NATIVE_PIP_RUNTIME_WHEELS_PRESENT_BUT_PEP517_BUILD_DEPENDENCY_MISSING',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:separate_offline_build_isolation_and_runtime_dependency_closures',flush=True)
 try:task.deliver(run,case)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student offline build/runtime delivery failed') from error
 assert len(calls)==2 and calls[0][0]=='wheel' and calls[1][0]=='install' and all('--no-index' in args for args in calls)
 assert '--no-build-isolation' not in calls[0] and '--no-deps' in calls[0] and '--no-deps' not in calls[1]
 artifact=root/'output'/'opsforge_application-1.0-py3-none-any.whl';assert artifact.is_file()
 # No site-packages, pip, or build tools are available to this isolated runtime interpreter.
 probe="import sys,json,pathlib,importlib.util;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]);import opsforge_application;print(json.dumps(dict(answer=opsforge_application.ANSWER,build_helper=importlib.util.find_spec('opsforge_buildhelper') is not None,provenance=json.loads((pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])/'opsforge_build_provenance.json').read_text()))))"
 result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-S','-c',probe,case['target']],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=4)
 assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr
 assert json.loads(result.stdout)==dict(answer=49,build_helper=False,provenance=dict(build_dependency='1.0',isolated=True)),'build used ambient dependency or build tools leaked into runtime closure'
 assert sorted(p.name for p in (root/'installed').glob('*.dist-info'))==['opsforge_application-1.0.dist-info','opsforge_runtime-2.0.dist-info']
 bad={**case,'build_wheels':str(wrong),'output':str(root/'bad-output'),'target':str(root/'bad-target')};calls.clear()
 try:task.deliver(run,bad)
 except RuntimeError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('wrong build helper version silently accepted')
 assert len(calls)==1 and not (root/'bad-target').exists(),'failed build continued to runtime install'
 assert protected=={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for folder in (source,runtime,build,wrong) for p in folder.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
 assert case==original and importlib.util.find_spec('opsforge_buildhelper') is None
 print('NATIVE_PEP517_BUILD_HELPER_ISOLATED_RUNTIME_INSTALL_ONLY_APPLICATION_AND_RUNTIME_DEPENDENCY',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
